column1: # *** FOUND: SANCHO LLERENA AND MARIA FERNANDEZ IN THE CANELONES MARRIAGE INDEX, 1791. ***
# 14 September 2026. This archive has wanted this marriage for seven weeks and recorded it as
# unreachable, on the strength of a full-text search that found no Canelones marriage register.
# *** The register is filmed, it has an index, the index was opened, and the entry is in it. ***
*** THE ENTRY: 'LLERENA SANCHO CON MARIA FERNANDEZ', 1791 ***
column2: Canelones, Indice de matrimonios 1776-1947, DGS 8166578, *** IMAGE 2531 *** (ark 3:1:3Q9M-CS2Z-W2RG), under the heading *** LETRA L, sub-heading LIBRO I. *** Read across three DeepZoom tiles at level 12, on one aligned row: *** tile 5_5 gives the year column '1791.' and the name beginning 'Ll...'; tile 6_5 gives '...ena Sancho con'; tile 7_5 gives 'Maria Fernand[ez]'. ***
column3: *** PRIMARY for the INDEX ENTRY - the index page was opened and read here. It is an INDEX, not the act. ***
column4: *** THIS IS THE FIRST DOCUMENTARY CONFIRMATION THAT THE MARRIAGE HAPPENED AT CANELONES AT ALL. *** Until today the date 8 January 1791 came from Apolant ficha 355 and the VENUE came from nowhere - this archive supplied the word 'Canelones' itself and had been writing it as though sourced. *** A Canelones parish index now carries Sancho and Maria Fernandez under the year 1791. *** *** It also places the act in LIBRO I of Matrimonios *** - items 11-13 of the same reel, 'Matrimonios, Libros 1-3, (sep.) 1776-1854 (dic.)'. *** The ACT ITSELF HAS STILL NOT BEEN OPENED. ***

column1: *** WHAT THE INDEX DOES NOT GIVE ***
column2: No folio number could be read for this row. The opening's left page is blank and the entries sit on the right-hand page; the columns to the left of the year came back empty at level 12 (tiles 3_5 and 4_5), and the page's right edge is the binding. *** Other pages of this index DO carry folio numbers - image 2490 under Letra C showed folios 11, 11v, 15v, 16, 17, 17v, 18, 18v, 22 - so the column exists but is not filled for these earliest rows. ***
column4: *** So the act must be found by walking Libro I to January 1791, not by jumping to a folio. *** Libro I opens in September 1776, and the registers begin after the index ends, somewhere past image 2590.

column1: *** AND THE SURROUNDING ROWS CONFIRM THE READING IS NOT WISHFUL ***
column2: The same tile shows the neighbouring entries in the same hand and format: *** "...bel Manuel con...", "...s (ae) Felipe con...", "...ena SANCHO con...", "...ina Bartolo con...", "...os Juan Ygnacio...", "...(ae) Jose con..." *** and the year column beside them runs 1777, 1778, 1780, 1781, 1783, 1785, 1786, 1787, 1788, 1789, 1790, 1791, 1792 in order.
column4: *** The row is in sequence, in an alphabetical L section, in a chronological run, with a forename SANCHO and a bride MARIA FERNANDEZ. *** Those are the two names this archive has been able to put together from fourteen Uruguayan records, *** and MARIA FERNANDEZ is the one part of this man's identity that every record has always agreed on. *** *** What has NOT been verified is the exact day. *** The index gives a year. Apolant gives 8 January. The act will give the day, and until it is opened the two remain separate claims that agree.
